text: АО «Актив» has been the sole participant of ООО «Хантинг» since 21 September 2026, holding 100% of its capital.

source.name: Checko: ООО "ХАНТИНГ" (EGRUL data), company page
source.quote: АКЦИОНЕРНОЕ ОБЩЕСТВО "АКТИВ" ОГРН 1267700178514 с 21 сентября 2026 г. 10 тыс. руб. 100%
source.note: Founders-table row of the Checko page: АКЦИОНЕРНОЕ ОБЩЕСТВО "АКТИВ" (ОГРН 1267700178514) has been the participant since 21 September 2026, with 'Доля капитала' 100% (10 тыс. руб. of a 10,000-ruble capital). Checko's page for АО "АКТИВ" (checko.ru/company/1267700178514, opened 2026-10-03) says the JSC was registered 25 May 2026 in Moscow (activity: management of holding companies) and shows 'Нет сведений об учредителях' (no data on its founders/shareholders).
